correctness.rationale: Proof establishes integrality using formal power series, all parameter quantifiers, the off-diagonal Lucas residue p-r at each sufficiently large prime and diagonal residue s(s-1)/2 at 2 times each sufficiently large odd prime, with invertible denominators. These residues exclude every possible fixed multiplier via Dold divisibility. Singleton p=r=1 explicitly realizes the remaining sequence. Finite verifier checks 2,880 exact values, 1,942 prime congruences, 203 twice-prime congruences; these are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: Primary full text of Zhang arXiv:2302.09454v2 proves only the Catalan/Motzkin/Schroeder non-almost-realizability cases, not the full two-parameter Raney theorem; its use of prime-index Dold obstructions is explicitly acknowledged. Byszewski--Graff--Ward arXiv:2007.04031v4 records polynomial Dold rigidity, which covers the already-known p=1 subfamily, and gives general Dold conditions but no Raney classification. Beagley--Drube arXiv:1501.07137v1 gives plane-tree interpretations with no comparable dynamical theorem. Equivalent/alias/broader searches and a mathematical research index identified no covering all-parameter classification. Unindexed literature remains a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed equivalent proof or unpublished earlier classification cannot be excluded.
The polynomial p=1 subfamily and the ordinary Catalan (p,r)=(2,1) case are earlier corollaries, not being claimed independently new.
Several web results are abstracts only; these were not represented as full-text exclusion evidence.

value.rationale: Raney numbers are a natural two-parameter integer family counting generalized plane trees, and dynamical almost-realizability is a recognized integrality/arithmetic property. A complete if-and-only-if classification on all positive integer parameters is meaningful beyond individual examples. Crucially the prime-index obstruction vanishes along an infinite diagonal, where a second, structurally distinct twice-prime Möbius obstruction provides a uniform sharp answer. This is not a table calculation, arbitrary slice, or known Catalan special case restated.
